context: Grading a diagnostic tool for troubleshooting GitLab MR API access issues.

checklist.name: uses_get_mr_comments
checklist.description: Calls or integrates get_mr_comments.sh in the solution.

checklist.name: checks_gitlab_token
checklist.description: Verifies that GITLAB_TOKEN or GITLAB_PAT exists before making requests.

checklist.name: validates_url_format
checklist.description: Checks that the URL matches the expected merge_requests URL pattern.

checklist.name: handles_401
checklist.description: Detects authentication failures (HTTP 401) and provides feedback about token issues.

checklist.name: handles_404
checklist.description: Detects project-not-found errors (HTTP 404) and provides feedback about URL or access issues.

checklist.name: checks_exit_codes
checklist.description: Examines script exit codes (0 for success, 1 for errors) to detect failures.

checklist.name: mentions_read_api_scope
checklist.description: References or checks that the token has read_api scope as part of diagnostics.

checklist.name: validates_response_format
checklist.description: Checks that the response contains expected fields like Author: or Date: to ensure valid output.

checklist.name: actionable_suggestions
checklist.description: Includes suggestions for fixing detected problems.
